instruction: The precondition file is saved at /home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd. Open that file; it contains the base part shown in the before image and sketch(es) you will need. Build the target shape shown in the after image by adding the raised circular pads from the supplied sketch. Use Sketch001 for the raised pad feature; the pad height is 6 mm. Use Sketch002 to cut the circular holes through the raised pads as shown; create the pocket with a 5 mm length setting and cut in the reversed direction. Mirror the base pad, raised pad, and pocket across the existing Sketch mirror plane so the matching geometry appears on the opposite side as shown. Save the completed model to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
